description: Completeness of the FRAP historical fire perimeter record, measured as counts of cells in three named states. Nothing is estimated, nothing is interpolated across a gap, and no share is published over an empty denominator.

acre_thresholds.description: Records per decade counted against the acreages FRAP's published current collection criteria name. Not the criteria of every earlier era, and a record below a threshold is not an error.

by_decade.description: One row per decade, plus the no-year cohort.

acres_recorded.description: Of those, carrying a recorded acreage. The denominator for the counts below.

below.description: Threshold acreage to the count of records below it. Keys are the thresholds as strings.

decade.description: First year of the decade, or null for records carrying no year.

note.description: What these counts are and are not.

artifact_schema_version.description: The version of this contract. Bumped when a consumer validating against the previous schema would reject the new artifact or would read an existing key as meaning something else.

items.description: One duplicate-candidate signal: records sharing an identifier or an identifying combination. Candidates, not findings; this project does not decide that two records are the same fire.

description.description: What was keyed on, in words.

keyed_records.description: Records carrying a value for that key.

records_sharing_a_key.description: Records carrying a reused key value.

reused_keys.description: Key values carried by more than one record.

earliest_year.description: Earliest fire year carried by any record, or null if none carries one.

fields.description: Every measured field, in registry order.

items.description: Completeness of one measured field. The three counts are in the order published as `field_state_order`: present is a recorded value, explicit_unknown is a value the publisher records to mean it could not be determined, and not_recorded is an empty cell. A recorded unknown is neither present nor missing, and folding it into either one is the error this project exists to refuse.

explicit_unknown.description: Cells carrying a published marker meaning the value could not be determined (explicit_unknown).

label.description: Human-readable label from the field registry.

marker_basis.description: Whether the recorded-unknown markers for this field are the publisher's own (`published`) or this project's reading of the data (`inferred`). See docs/MARKERS.md.

markers.description: Which recorded-unknown marker was found, and how often. Keys are the publisher's spellings, which differ between eras of the same file.

name.description: Column name as the publisher spells it.

note.description: The field registry's note on this field. Absent where the registry carries none.

outside_published_domain.description: Recorded values that are not in the publisher's coded-value domain for this field. Null, never zero, where the layer publishes no domain: nothing was counted against a domain that does not exist, and a zero would say the file and the domain agree.

outside_published_domain_distinct.description: How many distinct such values were found. Null with no published domain.

outside_published_domain_values.description: Up to `OUTSIDE_DOMAIN_VALUE_CAP` of those values with their counts. Compare `outside_published_domain_values_listed` against `outside_published_domain_distinct` before reading this as the whole set. Null with no published domain.

outside_published_domain_values_listed.description: How many of the distinct values the object above actually names.

present_tenths_pct.description: Share of cells carrying a recorded value, in tenths of a percent, as an integer. Null where the denominator is zero: no share is published over an empty population.

recorded_zero_values.description: Cells recording a literal zero, for a field measured as a number. A zero is a judgment call (ADR 0006) and is published separately rather than folded into either presence or absence. Absent for a field that is not numeric.

total.description: The three counts summed. The denominator for this field.

irwin_id_present_tenths_pct.description: Share carrying an IRWIN identifier, in tenths of a percent, as an integer. Null where the denominator is zero: no share is published over an empty population.

is_fixture.description: True when this artifact was built from the committed sample fixtures rather than the publisher's file. A fixture build publishes no acquisition facts and its counts describe ten records.

latest_year.description: Latest fire year carried by any record, or null if none carries one.

marker_counterfactuals.description: The same keying run against a value this project does not treat as a marker, so a reader can see what the marker choice bought.

items.description: One duplicate-candidate signal: records sharing an identifier or an identifying combination. Candidates, not findings; this project does not decide that two records are the same fire.

description.description: What was keyed on, in words.

keyed_records.description: Records carrying a value for that key.

records_sharing_a_key.description: Records carrying a reused key value.

reused_keys.description: Key values carried by more than one record.

measurement.description: What this artifact measures, in one sentence.

records_without_year.description: Records carrying no fire year at all.

source.description: Provenance for the file this artifact measures, from the reviewed record in `perimeter.sources`. In a fixture build every acquisition fact is null.

acquired_bytes.description: Size of the downloaded file, or null in a fixture build.

acquired_record_count.description: Rows in the downloaded file, or null in a fixture build.

acquired_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded file, or null in a fixture build.

caveats.description: The publisher's own statements about where the data is incomplete, quoted, each with the measurement built from it.

items.description: One published limitation and the measurement that answers it.

measured_as.description: What this project counts in response.

data_card.description: Path to the data card for this source in the repository.

data_tier.description: This project's governance tier for the source.

endpoint.description: The service endpoint the rows were queried from.

refresh_cadence.description: When this project re-pulls the source, in words.

retrieved.description: ISO date the file was downloaded, or null in a fixture build.

staleness_sla_days.description: How long a retrieval is taken to describe the published file. This project's declaration, not a commitment by the publisher. Nothing here computes staleness: the artifacts carry no clock, so a consumer subtracts `retrieved` from its own.

title.description: The publisher's title for the dataset.

version.description: The publisher's version string, or null in a fixture build.

years.description: One row per fire year, plus one row for the records carrying no year. Years are not interpolated and no year is invented for a record that carries none.

items.description: One fire year, or the cohort of records carrying no year.

irwin_explicit_unknown.description: Carrying a recorded-unknown marker in that field.

irwin_present.description: Of those, carrying an IRWIN identifier.

irwin_present_tenths_pct.description: Share of this cohort carrying an IRWIN identifier, in tenths of a percent, as an integer. Null where the denominator is zero: no share is published over an empty population.

year.description: The fire year, or null for the no-year cohort.

title: Perimeter: FRAP fire perimeter completeness
